name: Text to Speech
description: Convert text to natural speech. Internal mode uses the OAIY DramaBox engine (local, fast, voice cloning). External mode drives any HTTP TTS service (ElevenLabs, OpenAI, Chatterbox, your own).
doc:
Generate natural-sounding speech from text.

## Two modes

**Internal** — DramaBox running natively in OAIY (no Python, no server). Realtime on a recent GPU. Connect a 5-15 s reference wav to the **voice** pin for voice cloning.

**External** — drive any HTTP TTS endpoint via a request/response template. Presets ship for ElevenLabs, OpenAI, Chatterbox, and Qwen3; pick **Custom** to point at your own service.

## Pins

• **Text (in)** — what to say
• **Description (in)** — optional voice-style hint (overrides the Voice Description field when connected)
• **Voice (in)** — reference wav for voice cloning (Internal) or to fill `{{voiceRefPath}}` (External)
• **Audio (out)** — playable media URL
• **Path (out)** — absolute file path for Save Audio / FFmpeg / diffusion-video audio input

inputs.name: Description
inputs.description: Voice description (overrides the Voice Description field when connected)

inputs.name: Voice
inputs.description: Reference audio (5-15 s WAV) for voice cloning. Internal + External both honour it.

outputs.name: Audio
outputs.description: Generated audio (media URL for playback / video-diffusion audio pin)

outputs.name: Path
outputs.description: Absolute file path of the generated audio (for Save Audio / FFmpeg)

properties.name: Service Preset
properties.description: Pick a registered TTS service (manage in Settings → Services) to auto-fill the URL + headers + body template. Inline external* fields below still override. Leave blank to fill manually.

properties.name: Mode
properties.description: Local TTS via an HTTP service (Chatterbox / Qwen3 TTS / Custom). The bundled DramaBox engine was removed in the local-first build.

properties.name: Model
properties.description: Local TTS model. Auto-downloads weights on first use.

properties.name: Guidance (CFG)
properties.description: Classifier-Free Guidance. 2.5 is the ResembleAI default; higher = more on-prompt but can introduce echo/distortion; lower = more freedom.

properties.name: Duration (s)
properties.description: Target output length in seconds. Leave blank or set 0 to let DramaBox auto-size from the dialogue length (recommended). Override with 3–20 to force a specific clip length; the model clamps at 20 s.

properties.name: Streaming
properties.description: Emit audio in ~1s chunks as they're vocoded (per-chunk Tauri events). For low-latency playback. Final saved file is identical either way.

properties.name: Fast mode (skip BWE)
properties.description: Skip the bandwidth-extension generator. ~20% faster end-to-end, slightly muffled above ~7 kHz. Good for previews.

properties.name: Seed
properties.description: Random seed for reproducibility. 0 = randomize each call.

properties.name: Service
properties.description: Pick a service to auto-fill URL + auth + body. Choose Custom to author your own.

properties.name: API URL
properties.description: Full endpoint URL. Templates may use {{speaker}}, {{language}}, etc.

properties.name: API Key (secret name)
properties.description: Name of an OAIY secret containing the API key. Exposed as {{apiKey}} in headers + body. Leave blank for unauthenticated local services.

properties.name: Headers (JSON)
properties.description: HTTP headers as JSON. {{apiKey}} resolves the secret above.

properties.name: Body (template)
properties.description: Request body. {{text}} {{voiceRefPath}} {{description}} {{speaker}} {{language}} are auto JSON-escaped + quoted; use {{textRaw}} etc. for raw substitution.

properties.name: Response Type
properties.description: How the API returns audio. Binary = raw response body; file_path/url = JSON field at Response Path.

properties.name: Response Path (JSON only)
properties.description: Dot/bracket path into the JSON response (e.g. 'audio_path', 'data.url', '[0].audio'). Ignored for binary_* response types.

properties.name: Voice Description
properties.description: Optional voice-style hint, e.g. 'A warm narrator', 'A cheerful young woman'. Used by Internal and as {{description}} in External templates.

properties.name: Speaker / Voice ID
properties.description: External: voice/speaker ID (e.g. ElevenLabs voice ID, 'alloy' for OpenAI). Internal ignores.

properties.name: Language
properties.description: Language hint. Internal auto-detects; External passes as {{language}}.

properties.name: Filename
properties.description: Base filename for the saved audio (no extension).
